original_defect.summary: The external GFX review plan reports a 13x32 drill silhouette touching the top and bottom edges and using only 41% of the tile width, so it appeared clipped and narrow.

imagegen.prompt_exact_text:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Hearts of Iron IV decision icon, exact target 32x32 RGBA with genuine transparency.
Primary request: Create a wider, readable drill rig icon for a deeper underground test.
Input image 1: current decision_resources_found_deeper_test decoded from its runtime DDS, subject-only anchor. Preserve the drilling and deeper-test meaning, but replace the narrow edge-touching vertical shape with a wider complete drill composition.
Input image 2: canonical decision_tungsten.png from the vanilla Decisions family, style-only anchor. Transfer compact painted metal-and-stone shading and dark contour treatment; do not copy its mineral subject.
Scene/backdrop: none; unused canvas genuinely transparent.
Subject: a compact hand-operated core drill rig above a short bore shaft, with a sturdy horizontal crossbar and side grips around a broad central bronze drill head. Include only a small broken-rock base to explain the bore.
Style: aged bronze drill fittings, dark iron shaft, muted stone; painted 3D object art with clean contours and strong contrast.
Composition/framing: square 32x32 decision tile; make the rig wider than the old texture, fitting about 26x28 px with a 2 px transparent margin on every side. Keep the complete drill and handle inside the canvas.
Lighting/mood: practical exploration equipment, restrained warm metallic highlights.
Materials/textures: bronze collars, dark iron drill, rough but simple stone at the bore mouth.
Constraints: one static icon; solid opaque subject interior with antialiasing only on the outer edge; native-size clarity; no text.
Avoid: a long thin spike, a full mine scene, people, flags, lettering, numbers, fake checkerboard, opaque or chroma background, broad glow, blur, white outline, sticker border, clipping, or copied reference artwork.

input_roles.role: current runtime DDS decode; subject-only anchor
canonical decision icon; style-only metal shading anchor

processed_png.processing: Alpha>=8 defines complete subject bounds; exterior alpha 1-7 outside those bounds was cleared; premultiplied-alpha Lanczos contain resize; no opaque background removal and no visual component layer.

runtime_dds_validation.native_pixel_comparison: Raw BGRA payload equality and Pillow DDS RGBA decode are both exact against the processed PNG.
contact_sheet_contents: original runtime DDS native and 4x view

parent_visual_acceptance.basis: Parent accepted after native-size and 4x before/after review.
parent_visual_acceptance.accepted_note: Deeper Test at 32x32 as a wider uncut drill.
